flags: Capacity: strong. On pace to exceed 1bn USD annual revenue on a consolidated basis (Nutrabolt release, 9 Sep 2025); Keurig Dr Pepper sales, distribution and equity deal since Dec 2022.

Ownership: nutrabolt.com shows the Dec 2022 Keurig Dr Pepper equity investment and distribution deal. The Crunchbase note's KKR shareholding was not confirmed. Nutrabolt also holds a stake in Bloom Nutrition (20% in Jan 2024, expanded Sept 2025).

Grid: energy drinks are crowded. Red Bull owns two teams; Monster Energy (McLaren), Celsius (Aston Martin, exclusive since Jan 2026), MISSION (Alpine supplier); sports nutrition Optimum Nutrition (McLaren), HMN24 (Alpine), Liquid IV (McLaren). PepsiCo is at Mercedes. Ferrari has had no energy drink since Celsius left after 2025: best opening, with Williams, Haas, Audi and Cadillac.
Markets: US, Canada (Mississauga office), UK (Great Place To Work certification) and India (Dec 2025 licensing deal) confirmed; the 125-country reach is company-stated. No race in India.
Sports marketing track record: C4 Energy is official energy drink of the Lakers (Mar 2026), Knicks and Heat, plus Canada Basketball and Austin FC; no motorsport deal found.
